decisions.decision: Use common-ledger মিশ্র ভগ্নাংশ, not unbridged মিশ্র সংখ্যা. Use অপ্রকৃত ভগ্নাংশ for improper fraction. Translate the source link label with the existing module-title registry wording চিত্রের সাহায্যে ভগ্নাংশ বোঝা while preserving document=m81285.

The source -1 7/8 means -(1+7/8)=-15/8, and -3 2/5 means -(3+2/5)=-17/5. Explain the sign scope in the worked conversion row. Keep the original minus-token encoding, spacing, parentheses and all subsequent negative answers unchanged.

Retain the source preference for improper-fraction answers in algebra. Explain explicitly that the source mixed notation 2 1/12 adds the fractional part to 2, while 2 times 1/12 is multiplication. Keep all three source formulas unchanged; their values are 25/12, 25/12 and 1/6.

The first division example converts one mixed number and also writes 5 as 5/1; describe both visible operations instead of implying that 5 is itself a mixed number. State that the divisor cannot be zero. Use common-ledger গুণাত্মক বিপরীত, with its previously recorded provisional/editorial provenance.

Translate look for common factors and remove common factors as identifying common numerator/denominator factors and dividing both by them. Preserve every original combining cancellation slash in MathML mn text. The rational verifier strips the annotation only in its temporary calculation input, never in source or output. Integer answers 2 and -15 remain source-native text; improper fractions remain improper fractions.
